title: Linux Kernel, Hardware, and System Internals
learning_outcomes: Relate kernel interfaces, processes, memory, modules, drivers, and hardware discovery to observable system behavior.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.
